name: Lode
author: E. T. Carter
description: A mine shaft sunk through ore-bearing rock, seen straight down the bore. Near-black FBM stone walls salted with tiny hash-scattered mineral glints, a few glowing ore veins threading the rock, and one warm waist of light — a stationary lamp band at fixed screen radius. The wall pours perpetually down the scale axis through the lamp toward a true-black focal depth at the centre.

params.label: Descent speed
params.effect: Scale-octaves per second the rock pours past the lamp.

params.label: Glint density
params.effect: Fraction of wall cells carrying a mineral sparkle, applied as a hash threshold.

params.label: Lamp depth
params.effect: Screen radius of the stationary lamplight band, as a fraction of the frame's half-size.

params.label: Vein glow
params.effect: Brightness of the ore veins threading the rock.
